request.draft: Explain the words only if in this paragraph.

sources.text: Route C remains open, but a vessel may enter it only if its navigation beacon is operational. The beacon must be checked in its installed configuration before departure. Permission to work on a vessel does not remove this requirement, nor does the fact that another vessel has already left the harbour.

items.text: only if 表示必要条件：不满足这个条件就不能做前面的事，但这一处措辞没有声称它就是全部条件。
